Y
Non-Profit Directors & Officers
Manual Rates
Travelers Casualty and Surety Company of America  
California
Filing Number:  2008-11-0006
  
EXPERIENCE MODIFICATION PLAN
Experience modification does not apply if insured does not have one full experience year.
   
Experience modification factors relate to directors' and officers' claims or litigation that have been brought against 
the insured.  A modification factor is applied based on claim experience and is applied as follows:
Modification
Factors
1.00 - 1.00
1.00 - 1.20
1.20 - 1.40
1.40 - 1.60
Definitions for above criteria:
No claims reported, or claims reported have had either no payout or a low 
likelihood of ultimate payout.
Little to no impact on overall earnings or financial condition; Little to no loss paid 
by carrier
Impact on overall earnings or financial condition; the carrier has paid in excess of 
retention
Significant impact on overall earnings or financial condition; the carrier has paid 
significantly in excess of retention
Major
Description
None  - Immaterial
Minimal
Material
None  - Immaterial
Minimal
Material
Major
